_meta: #252 curated surface-form alias map (forward prevention). Each `merges` entry collapses exact surface-form variants of ONE specific entity onto a single canonical record at registry match-time, so re-extraction never re-forks them (e.g. the three HMC-1 forms -> one). Keyed on the EXACT normalized variant string (zero fuzzy risk); the operator extends the list as new variants appear. `class` is an opaque equivalence-class token (synthetic key `cl::<class>`, cannot collide with a real name); `canonical` is the preferred display the merged record shows; `variants` are the exact surface forms to fold in. `keep_separate` is the never-merge guard: an embedding nearest-neighbour that would fold either side into the other is blocked (recorded, never silent) — these are biologically distinct lines that share a designator (parent vs knockout/derivative, or HEK293 vs HEK293T which carries SV40 large-T antigen). Seeded from the 2026-06-22 live-artifact fork probe over entities.json (235 cell-line entities); only the clean, unambiguous merges are listed. Loaded by ToolRegistry; absent file -> no merges, no guards (fail-open). A keep_separate pair that is also merged is a curation error and fails loud at load.
keep_separate: stably transfected HEK293T reporter cell line
